Discover Giloy Powder from Tradenest Naturals

Giloy powder is made from the dried stems of Tinospora cordifolia, a climbing plant traditionally used in Ayurvedic formulations. Tradenest Naturals is a giloy powder manufacturer india supplying herbal brands and distributors worldwide. Our production uses mature stems, cleaned and dehydrated before milling. As a giloy powder exporter, we pair traditional know-how with modern drying and milling equipment. You get a steady, well-documented herbal powder for your range.

Why Choose Our Wholesale Giloy Powder?

A fair wholesale giloy powder price matters when you plan a product line. We quote competitive rates for bulk buyers. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers, which keeps our supply chain short. Our pure giloy powder bulk buy options suit brands of different sizes. Whether you need tinospora cordifolia powder wholesale or a custom pack format, we can work to your needs. Every lot is milled to the same 80-100 mesh standard.

Manufacturing and Quality Standards

Our process is simple and controlled. First, we select mature stems of Tinospora cordifolia. Second, we wash and dehydrate the material. Next, we mill the dried stems into a fine powder. Finally, we sieve it to an even mesh size. Each lot is checked for colour, texture and moisture. As an ayurvedic herb exporter india, we provide export documentation support and keep batch records.

FAQ: Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for giloy powder manufacturer india?

Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg. This suits emerging brands as well as larger buyers. Contact our sales team to discuss your volumes.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

We are an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We offer several pack formats, including stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers and bulk export bags. The powder has a shelf life of 24 months when stored correctly.

What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)?

Our standard giloy powder is dehydrated and milled to 80-100 mesh. Moisture is kept at or below 8%, and the powder contains no additives.

What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote?

Lead time depends on order volume and packing, and we confirm it on each quotation. You can request a sample or a formal quote through our website or our export desk.

Applications and Buyer Value

Giloy powder is used in several product types. Formulators fill it into capsules and tablets or blend it into herbal teas. It is also used in traditional Ayurvedic churna blends. With us, you gain a dependable supply partner and clear product information.
